preconditions.description: The length of the sequences a and b must be between 1 and 100,000.
The boundaries of the segment where the elements of sequences a and b are must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(l <= a[i] <= r for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of sequence a must be within the range [l, r].

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The compressed sequence p must contain n distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(l <= b[i] <= r for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no suitable sequence b exists, output '-1'. Otherwise, output a sequence b of length n with elements within the range [l, r].

postconditions.expression: all(b[i] - a[i] == c[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The calculated sequence c must satisfy c[i] = b[i] - a[i] for all i.
The compressed sequence of c must be a permutation of integers from 1 to n.
